name: Beskonechnaja doroga v Pripjat'
source: A young but experienced mercenary named Semyon heads into the Zone under the callsign Pioneer, seeking a ghost town where something of great value to the entire world is hidden. But this mission was never meant to be easy. As Pioneer, you’ll have to fight your way from Zaton to Pripyat - but can both of you make it?
translation: 一位名叫谢苗（Semyon）的年轻但经验丰富的雇佣兵以呼号“先锋”（Pioneer）进入该区域，寻找一座鬼城，那里隐藏着对整个世界具有巨大价值的东西。但这个任务从来都不是一件容易的事。作为先锋，你必须从扎通一路杀到普里皮亚特 - 但你们俩能成功吗？
